P01.rationale: A large portrait of a person (the client/founder) occupies roughly the left half of the page at meaningful size, serving as a strong human anchor, though it is a client rather than a founder figure.

P05.rationale: The client portrait is clearly framed and named with company attribution beneath it, occupying a substantial portion of the left column, though it is the only case study shown on this page.

P07.rationale: There is no press/logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus visible; the quote text is present but rendered nearly illegible and lacks a structured social-proof layout.

P10.rationale: Large quotation mark glyphs appear before the testimonial block, but they are modest in scale and not used as bold decorative oversized typographic elements in the manner of the references.

P11.rationale: A horizontal bar chart comparing before/after go-live durations is present and bound to specific numeric data (8 months vs. 2 months), providing a real data visualisation.

P12.rationale: The layout is reasonably well-filled with a large portrait, structured text sections, a chart, and large metric callouts, though the right column has some loose spacing around the testimonial area.

P13.rationale: The background is a very subtle warm off-white/cream tone with minimal texture; it is not entirely flat but lacks the deliberate atmospheric texture seen in the reference pages.

P14.rationale: The portrait photo does not use a full-bleed treatment with a scrim, but the text is placed outside the image area, so readability is maintained without needing a scrim.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) is present anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The portrait appears to be a real, specific individual in a recognisable setting, reducing the generic stock feel, though the background of the photo is somewhat generic.

N08.rationale: There is some loose whitespace in the lower-right testimonial area where the blurred/faded quote text leaves a visually empty region, but overall the page is reasonably filled.

N10.rationale: The testimonial quote text is overlaid directly on what appears to be a lightly textured or photo background without a scrim, making it nearly unreadable and creating an awkward visual gap.
